title: D5 agent output (d5-older-line-finder)
description: Section 12/D5 'Agent output' line and .claude/agents/d5-older-line-finder.md's worked output shape: {"older": [{"for","passage_id","exact_line"}], "none_for": [...], "note"}. The `for` labels are the same labels D4 used (spec 12/D5 Agent output: 'same `for` labels as D4'). Every cross-check that needs the per-item input context — exact_line found WORD FOR WORD in the OLDER edition (spec 12/D5 Checks), passage_id among the older passages actually handed over, and the agent file's own 'Never quote the latest edition here' rule — lives in scripts/checks/D5.py, the same split as every other agent-output schema in this build (schemas/D4.json, schemas/C1.json).

for.description: What this older line covers, using the SAME label D4 used for that part (e.g. 'answer', 'rule', 'statement B', 'statement C is false', 'List I-P matches List II-2').

passage_id.description: An OLDER-edition passage id from the input's older_passages only (book-id letter 'O'). checks/D5.py rejects a latest-edition ('L') id outright.

exact_line.description: One continuous span copied character-for-character from that passage. No ellipses (quote_verify.find rejects '...' and '…' outright).

none_for.description: The `for` labels for which the older book has no such line at all. A label must not appear in both `older` and `none_for` (checked in scripts/checks/D5.py).

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
